te: Doctor: Bengal lights can cause dangerous substances to enter the lungs
de: Frequent use of Bengal lights in enclosed spaces can lead to the accumulation of harmful substances in the air, irritation of the respiratory tract and allergic reactions, told RT allergist Vladimir Bolibok.
